name: shipitfam
description: Drive your ShipItFam AI dev crew from ChatGPT or Codex: create projects from starters, start missions, answer the crew, review previews and ship.

interface.longDescription: ShipItFam is an AI dev team you keep on a leash. Describe a goal and a crew of specialist agents plans and builds it, and nothing risky or final happens without your approval. Connect your account, then create projects from starters, start missions, answer the crew's questions, approve plans, review live previews and ship to your repo, all from the conversation.
defaultPrompt: What does my ShipItFam crew need from me right now?
Start a ShipItFam mission: add a pricing section to my landing page
Show me the preview of my latest ShipItFam mission and help me ship it
